nodes.name: PLG + ICP Scoring
nodes.notes: Dual-track scoring engine. Block A scores firmographic ICP fit (0–100). Block B scores PLG behavioral signals (0–100). Composite = 40% ICP + 60% PLG. Classifies each account into a motion: PQL, Expansion, Nurture, or Disqualify.

nodes.name: Route by Motion
nodes.notes: Routes each account to a different downstream path based on its motion. PQL → Claude writes outreach trigger. Expansion → Claude writes upsell angle. Nurture → Claude writes re-engagement note. Disqualify → skip AI, write directly to CRM as disqualified.

parameters.jsCode:
const item = $input.first().json;

return [{
  json: {
    account_id:         item.account_id || '',
    email:              item.email || '',
    company:            item.company || item.company_name || '',
    title:              item.title || item.job_title || '',
    motion:             'Disqualify',
    tier:               item.tier || 'D',
    icp_score:          item.icp_score || 0,
    plg_score:          item.plg_score || 0,
    composite_score:    item.composite_score || 0,
    plan:               item.plan || 'free',
    icp_signals:        Array.isArray(item.icp_signals) ? item.icp_signals.join(', ') : (item.icp_signals || ''),
    plg_signals:        Array.isArray(item.plg_signals) ? item.plg_signals.join(', ') : (item.plg_signals || ''),
    flags:              Array.isArray(item.flags) ? item.flags.join(', ') : (item.flags || ''),
    why_now:            'Does not meet ICP or usage threshold.',
    pain_hypothesis:    'Account does not match Air\'s core ICP criteria.',
    outreach_hook:      '',
    recommended_action: 'Remove from pipeline',
    urgency:            'Low'
  }
}];

nodes.name: Disqualify (no AI)
nodes.notes: Disqualified accounts skip Claude entirely and get a default brief.
